lastCompletedStory.title: Clear frame on width-change in dashboard poll re-render path

nextStoryContext: US-001 added a non-React, directly-testable factory `makePollWidthClearer` (src/ui/Dashboard.tsx) mirroring `makeResizeClearer`'s (src/commands/dashboard.ts) fake-writeFn shape: it tracks the column width across DashboardApp's poll ticks and writes CURSOR.clear (imported as a value from commands/dashboard.ts) before the poll-driven setData repaint iff stdout.columns changed since the previous tick, swallowing a failed write (try/catch) so a broken writeFn can never crash the setInterval. DashboardAppProps gained an optional `writeFn` prop (defaults to process.stdout.write) purely for test injection; production callers pass nothing. Width is read fresh at each tick from the live `stdout` object returned by Ink's useStdout() (real process.stdout in production; a fixed-columns=100 fake in ink-testing-library, which is why the new unit tests exercise the factory directly rather than through an Ink render -- ink-testing-library's fake Stdout.columns is a hardcoded getter with no seam to vary it between ticks, so there is no way to drive a width-change scenario through a full DashboardApp Ink render; any future story wanting an Ink-level width-change regression would need a custom Ink render with a hand-built stdout-like object, bypassing ink-testing-library entirely). makeResizeClearer (dashboard.ts) and its resize listener registration were left untouched (belt-and-suspenders, per AC3). File-size ceilings raised for src/ui/Dashboard.tsx (660->726) and test/dashboard.test.ts (1836->1901) in scripts/file-size-budget.json, _ref updated with CAM-306 dated note.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed useStdout() returns { stdout, write } where stdout defaults to the real process.stdout stream; reading stdout.columns at poll-tick time (rather than via useWindowSize()) is a valid, doc-consistent way to observe live terminal width without adding a second hook/re-render source.
